title: Recipe 09: Expose three safe capabilities
titleZh: 方案09：向外部 Agent 开放三个安全能力
summary: An editorial queue exposes list, approve, and comment to an external client. A delete action remains available to the page assistant but is rejected by the external allowlist.
summaryZh: 编辑队列只向外部客户端暴露列表、通过与备注三项能力。删除仍可由页面内助手使用，但不在外部白名单中，因此会被协议拒绝。

files.label: App.vue
files.role: Records, page tools, and Surface allowlist
files.roleZh: 记录、页面工具与能力面白名单

guide.title: Exposure is a whitelist, not a filter on an API dump
guide.titleZh: 开放能力是白名单，不是把 API 过滤一遍
intro: The page and the external client share one registry and one executor, but they do not see the same capabilities.
Call describe, invoke the three exposed capabilities, then try article_delete. The last request fails before the business handler runs.
introZh: 页面与外部客户端共用一份注册表和执行器，但看到的能力并不相同。
先调用 describe，再调用三项白名单能力，最后尝试 article_delete。最后一次请求会在业务函数执行前失败。

steps.title: Reuse the page executor
steps.body: The surface receives the existing registry and executor. It does not implement a second route into page state.
steps.bodyZh: 能力面接收现有注册表与执行器，不另建一条进入页面状态的执行路径。

steps.title: Name the external allowlist
steps.body: Only list, approve, and comment are exposed. The exact list is visible in the response and in page state.
steps.bodyZh: 只暴露列表、通过与备注。实际白名单同时出现在协议响应与页面状态中。

steps.title: Keep delete inside the page boundary
steps.titleZh: 把删除留在页面边界内
steps.body: The delete tool exists for the in-page assistant, but its id is absent from the external allowlist.
steps.bodyZh: 删除工具仍供页面内助手使用，但它的 id 不在外部白名单里。

guide.note: Open the External client panel. A successful describe shows three capabilities; article_delete returns CAPABILITY_NOT_EXPOSED.
guide.noteZh: 查看“外部客户端”面板。describe 只返回三项能力；article_delete 返回 CAPABILITY_NOT_EXPOSED。
